dpc_direction: official row-density greater than column; lower-density neighbors
dynamic_ties: saliency descending then actual token index
source_history: most recent four reduced frame blocks, selectively dequantized; inherited ancestors recorded; native whole-video context retained
quantization_ranges: FP32 per-layer/K-or-V/head/channel across current frame visual rows only
odd_visual_count: one storage-only zero nibble, no logical token padding
text_KV: source text and boundary rows retained full original BF16 precision
source_keys: mean post-k_norm/pre-RoPE actual reduced visual K per layer, 8KV heads concatenated, FP32 CPU
source_time_text: Actual source frame at {time:.3f} seconds. This is contextual media and is not proof that an act occurs in the current window.
question_query: mean actual question-content rows post-q_norm/pre-RoPE; 32Q to8KV by mean four contiguous group heads; FP32 CPU cosine; stable actual source-index ties
LOCAL: all actual source frames in half-open current8s window, uncompressed original projector/all DeepStack reused from fresh single-frame vision; no source-KV ancestry in LOCAL embeddings
reader_role_text: Current LOCAL images retain their actual source times. Retrieved compressed memory is context from elsewhere in the same video; it is not an event in the current window. Decide the original visual question using current-window evidence, with remote context only for interpretation.
positions: source visual roots preserve original three-axis positions; context blocks translate by one common integer across all axes in source order; complete LOCAL/question suffix translates as one three-axis block after selected context at each layer; native positions/KV unchanged
speech: fresh original native independent S and None when original body empty
global_stance: fresh original native G and own hard stance
source_pixels: read-only original actual0.5fps cache with current raw PTS/RGB replay; missing cache generated under independently shared sampler/extractor, not rescored labels
proof_persistence: Full projector/allDeepStack, compressed projector/allDeepStack + representatives/groups/input/position/cost traces persistent; separate per-video working features and quantized/fulltext KV temporary, validated before atomic complete record then released
